title: Timeline
description: An animation timeline for an editor panel, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Toggle, Tooltip and Slider primitives: play/pause and loop toggles with a "current / duration" readout in m:ss:ff, a time ruler that is a single-thumb Slider (the playhead, with its time marks as markers), and one row per animated property whose keyframes are the thumbs of a Slider with no range; a playhead line crosses every track. Controlled only: it renders tracks, time, playing, loop and the selected keyframe as given and reports every change (times snapped to 1 / fps); it holds no clock. Space plays and pauses, Page Up/Down move a thumb one second; the track list scrolls under a sticky ruler; responds to its container (@container) — the label column widens at @sm and every ruler mark shows at @md.
